title: Philippines PCSO Draw Schedule and Result Format
subtitle: Normal draw days, Philippine-time draw windows, result formats, and field definitions for major PCSO games.
description: A small public-information dataset for checking normal PCSO draw schedules and result formats. It covers 2D, 3D, 4D, 6D, Lotto 6/42, Mega Lotto 6/45, Super Lotto 6/49, Grand Lotto 6/55, and Ultra Lotto 6/58. Holiday suspensions, special draws, and official advisories may change the schedule. Always use official PCSO channels for final confirmation.

resources.description: Normal draw days, times, result formats, official source, and LottoLens reference pages.
